name: Can easy grip door hardware be installed on any type of door?

mainEntity.name: Can easy grip door hardware be installed on any type of door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, easy grip door hardware can be installed on most standard residential and commercial doors, including interior passage doors, privacy doors, and exterior entry doors. However, some older or custom doors may require minor modifications to the bore holes or mortises to ensure a proper fit. Our expert technicians at City Dweller, LLC can assess your existing doors to determine compatibility and recommend the best installation approach to achieve optimal functionality and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard doors can accommodate easy grip hardware, but some may need minor modifications. Our technicians can assess compatibility and recommend solutions.
